title: Sociology
sourceText:
Academic Programs and Pathways

Degrees and Certificates

Sociology

Sociology

Explore our social landscapes–from neighborhoods to nations–and discover how they shape our place in society. You’ll learn about the ways we interact with one another, construct social meaning, and understand our sense of self. Sociology offers five tracks to get you major ready to transfer: Business, Education, Health and Society, Law and Justice, and Social Services.

          Sociology Faculty

          Visit Sociology Faculty page

Our dynamic faculty have extensive teaching, research, and community engagement experiences. 

With a wide range of sociological expertise and backgrounds, we offer a breadth of courses that foster intellectual curiosity, advance students’ careers, and promote lifelong learning. We are passionate about the field of Sociology and love working closely with our students to empower them to build stronger communities and make the world a better place.
